[EVENT] User's grandmother brought up the topic of obtaining a Portuguese passport for the user and their siblings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Obtaining a Portuguese passport can connect the user with their heritage and open travel and residency opportunities in Europe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may be eligible for Portuguese citizenship through descent, known as "jus sanguinis" or "right of blood."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User's grandmother must have been a Portuguese citizen at the time of the user's parent's birth for the user to qualify.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Required documents include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Grandmother's Portuguese birth certificate (original or certified copy).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Parent's birth certificate (original or certified copy).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - User's birth certificate (original or certified copy).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Proof of grandmother's Portuguese citizenship at the time of parent's birth (e.g., passport, ID card, or naturalization certificate).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Proof of parent's identity (e.g., passport, ID card, or driver's license).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User needs to register their birth in the Portuguese civil registry before applying for citizenship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can apply for Portuguese citizenship through descent at a Portuguese consulate or embassy or through a registered Portuguese lawyer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User will need to wait for processing, which may take several months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In some cases, a citizenship test on Portuguese history, culture, and language may be required.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once approved, the user will receive a Portuguese citizenship certificate.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] With the citizenship certificate, the user can apply for a Portuguese passport at a consulate or embassy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should check specific requirements and procedures with the Portuguese consulate or embassy in their country, as they may vary.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may consider hiring a registered Portuguese lawyer to assist with the application process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should be prepared for a potentially lengthy process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If the user has siblings, they will need to go through the same process to obtain their own Portuguese passports.
